notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.34.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Moi lan dung tu file tong the, addin luu cau hinh hang muc (kich thuoc, truc, chieu cao tang, doc mai, MC, san duong tiep giap) vao file mau.
